scenarios.title: Kerberoasting behavior
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review service-ticket activity against account and service baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare DC ticket records with an independently recorded authorized test and established application usage.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine service authentication and scheduled jobs.
scenarios.limitations: A ticket request alone does not establish password recovery or compromise.

scenarios.title: AS-REP roasting behavior
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review unusual authentication requests and preauthentication status
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review successful authentication records with the account policy snapshot and independently documented lab activity.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved accounts with legacy authentication exceptions.
scenarios.limitations: Failed preauthentication alone does not establish this technique; ticket acquisition does not establish password recovery.

scenarios.title: Golden ticket suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Correlate identity sensor alerts and ticket history; missing history alone is insufficient
scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate identity alerts with historical DC and endpoint records and the independent incident or lab record.
scenarios.negative_control: Legitimate long-running sessions and incomplete retention.
scenarios.limitations: Missing ticket history is not evidence of forgery.

scenarios.title: Silver ticket suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review service-side logons and available KDC evidence; account for cached tickets
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review service-side authentication evidence alongside identity alerts and retained DC records for the scoped session.
scenarios.negative_control: Ordinary service sessions and cached credentials.
scenarios.limitations: Missing DC events alone cannot establish ticket forgery.

scenarios.title: Pass-the-ticket suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review unexpected account and device combinations with EDR context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Corroborate the scoped identity alert with session records and independently documented activity.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved service or administrator sessions.
scenarios.limitations: Authentication records alone cannot establish ticket theft or reuse.

scenarios.title: Kerberos preauthentication failures
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review failures by account and approved client baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Group DC failure records by scoped account and time; compare reported client and failure reason with support records.
scenarios.negative_control: Expired cached credentials or user password errors.
scenarios.limitations: Failures alone do not establish malicious intent or successful authentication.

scenarios.title: TGT request anomalies
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare account and source against historical authentication patterns
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare observed TGT request identity, client and time with approved sign-in history and device inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: New workstation or scheduled service startup.
scenarios.limitations: A new client is not evidence of account compromise; schema varies by DC update.

scenarios.title: Service ticket failure anomalies
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review result codes and expected service activity
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review service-ticket failure status and service identity alongside outage or maintenance records.
scenarios.negative_control: Service rename, unavailable service or configuration error.
scenarios.limitations: A failed request does not establish successful service access.

scenarios.title: Ticket renewal anomalies
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare renewal activity with account usage policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare renewal timestamps and identity with documented service session lifetimes.
scenarios.negative_control: Long-running approved applications and ordinary renewals.
scenarios.limitations: Renewal records do not establish ticket theft.

scenarios.title: Legacy ticket encryption visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review negotiated encryption with migration inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare recorded ticket encryption type with service inventory and approved migration exceptions.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved legacy application compatibility.
scenarios.limitations: Ticket encryption is not necessarily the session-key encryption; verify event version.

scenarios.title: TGT encryption policy visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Check ticket encryption fields against approved policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review TGT encryption fields from the actual event version against the effective authentication baseline.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented compatibility exceptions during migration.
scenarios.limitations: Advertised or supported types do not establish which encryption was negotiated.

scenarios.title: Service account ticket volume
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review service usage changes with owner context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare scoped service account ticket totals to its own business-hour and batch-job history.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved batch workload or deployment spike.
scenarios.limitations: Volume alone is not proof of malicious activity; incomplete DC collection biases counts.

scenarios.title: Privileged account Kerberos usage
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare privileged identities with approved administration inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile privileged account authentication records with approved admin workstations and change windows.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented emergency maintenance or delegated administration.
scenarios.limitations: Privilege membership and a ticket event do not prove privileged action.

scenarios.title: Dormant identity Kerberos activity
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Correlate sign-in activity with identity lifecycle records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Join the authentication record to the identity owner, lifecycle status and approved access record.
scenarios.negative_control: Reactivated employee, maintenance or break-glass account.
scenarios.limitations: Dormancy alone does not establish unauthorized use.

scenarios.title: Unexpected client authentication
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare source identity with registered devices
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile client address at event time with device inventory, DHCP and approved remote access.
scenarios.negative_control: DHCP reassignment or approved VPN client.
scenarios.limitations: IP attribution can be ambiguous behind shared gateways.

scenarios.title: Service principal change
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review directory change audit against approved change tickets
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare the audited SPN attribute change and object identity with before/after directory snapshots and owner approval.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved service migration or rename.
scenarios.limitations: An object-change record alone does not establish subsequent ticket activity.

scenarios.title: Preauthentication setting change
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review account configuration changes with approval evidence
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare relevant account policy before and after the reported change with the documented exception and owner.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved legacy authentication exception.
scenarios.limitations: A general user change event does not identify the precise setting without attributes or snapshots.

scenarios.title: Kerberos delegation setting change
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review delegation-related configuration changes against baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare audited service configuration attribute changes with approved delegation inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Application onboarding or service migration.
scenarios.limitations: The event establishes a configuration observation, not actual delegated authentication.

scenarios.title: Kerberos event ingestion completeness
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare collector records with authoritative DC event export
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare equivalent bounded DC exports and collector records by source, record identifier and time after ingestion delay.
scenarios.negative_control: Collector maintenance or expected forwarding filters.
scenarios.limitations: Incomplete retention prevents a reliable missing-event conclusion; event IDs alone do not identify unique records.

scenarios.title: Kerberos policy baseline
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Audit Kerberos Authentication Service and Service Ticket Operations; collect all relevant DCs
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review effective ticket and encryption policies with administrator-provided snapshot
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective domain Kerberos policy and approved compatibility exceptions with the domain owner.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented compatibility setting with expiry and owner.
scenarios.limitations: A policy snapshot is not a runtime authentication or detection test.

scenarios.title: NTLM successful validation
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review approved legacy authentication baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review successful credential validation status on the authoritative source and reconcile the account with approved legacy inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine legacy application authentication.
scenarios.limitations: Credential validation is not proof of a specific destination session.

scenarios.title: NTLM failed validation
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review failure patterns with helpdesk context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review failure status, reported workstation and account against support tickets and time window.
scenarios.negative_control: Expired service password or user typing error.
scenarios.limitations: Failures alone do not establish malicious attempts or a subsequent success.

scenarios.title: NTLM network logon
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review authentication package and source inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: Confirm the authentication package and logon type in destination-host records; compare with approved client inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine file-share or service access.
scenarios.limitations: A network logon does not establish which business operation occurred.

scenarios.title: Pass-the-hash suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Correlate endpoint and DC evidence with identity sensor findings; not proof of hash use
scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate endpoint and identity alerts with scoped authentication records and independent incident evidence.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved legacy authentication and remote administration.
scenarios.limitations: NTLM event presence cannot distinguish password-based logon from credential-material misuse.

scenarios.title: NTLM password spray suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review account-distributed failures against known service disruptions
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review aggregate failed authentication records, scoped identity set, source health and service ownership.
scenarios.negative_control: Expired service credentials, misconfigured clients and legitimate user failures.
scenarios.limitations: Authentication failures do not identify the attempted secret or prove a spraying campaign.

scenarios.title: NTLM privileged account use
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review privileged authentication against tier policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate privileged identity inventory with approved administration records and destination logon evidence.
scenarios.negative_control: Authorized legacy administration exception.
scenarios.limitations: Validation events alone cannot establish privilege use at a destination.

scenarios.title: NTLM service account use
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare observed service identities with registered owners
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile service account usage with documented application ownership and expected host relationships.
scenarios.negative_control: Scheduled batch job or application restart.
scenarios.limitations: Shared service identity may limit attribution to a specific application.

scenarios.title: NTLM workstation mismatch
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Compare source identity and asset records with DHCP context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Resolve reported workstation and source-address context against time-valid inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Renamed workstation, DHCP change or remote access gateway.
scenarios.limitations: Reported workstation fields are not independent device identity proof.

scenarios.title: NTLM audit policy review
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review effective NTLM audit settings and coverage
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective NTLM auditing settings and a source-by-source collection inventory against the approved baseline.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented temporary policy exception.
scenarios.limitations: Policy snapshots do not prove actual event delivery; check separate telemetry evidence.

scenarios.title: NTLM restriction policy review
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review approved legacy exceptions and effective restriction settings
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare effective NTLM restriction policies with the approved legacy-service register and exception owner.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented staged migration or temporary compatibility exception.
scenarios.limitations: Configured policy does not establish enforcement on every host.

scenarios.title: NTLM relay suspicion
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review identity sensor findings with server authentication context; events alone do not establish relay
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review the existing identity-sensor finding and corroborating server authentication evidence with the incident timeline.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine integrated authentication or approved proxy architecture.
scenarios.limitations: Authentication records cannot independently establish relay; require qualified corroboration.

scenarios.title: NTLM channel visibility
scenarios.sources: DC and endpoint Security; NTLM Operational
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Credential Validation and Logon auditing; verify NTLM operational collection
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review collector health and source availability for NTLM operational events
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare NTLM operational channel availability and collector configuration across in-scope hosts.
scenarios.negative_control: Planned collector maintenance or approved channel filtering.
scenarios.limitations: Configured collection does not prove end-to-end delivery.

scenarios.title: LDAP unsigned bind audit
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review unsigned bind audit evidence and known legacy clients
scenarios.positive_evidence: Relevant DC Directory Service records identifying a client where the required diagnostic logging is enabled; verify client ownership and bind policy.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved signed or protected LDAP client sessions with an independently verified configuration.
scenarios.limitations: Diagnostic logging is not necessarily enabled and event absence cannot establish secure binds.

scenarios.title: LDAP signing posture
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review effective DC LDAP signing policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective LDAP signing configuration from approved domain-controller inventory and change records.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved time-limited compatibility exception.
scenarios.limitations: A snapshot does not prove all client connections are compliant.

scenarios.title: LDAP channel binding posture
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review effective channel binding policy and compatibility exceptions
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective channel-binding policy and documented client compatibility exceptions.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved temporary exception during migration.
scenarios.limitations: Configuration is not evidence of runtime enforcement.

scenarios.title: LDAP channel binding warning
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review channel binding audit diagnostics with client inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review Directory Service channel diagnostics and effective channel-binding policy; reconcile affected client with owner.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved compatibility remediation in progress.
scenarios.limitations: 3039 is policy and diagnostic dependent; absence is not assurance of successful enforcement.

scenarios.title: LDAP account discovery suspicion
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review directory query activity with diagnostic logging and approved administration baselines
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review directory diagnostic records with approved client inventory and the documented purpose of directory activity.
scenarios.negative_control: Identity inventory, address book synchronization and administration.
scenarios.limitations: Event 1644 is selective diagnostic logging, not comprehensive directory query coverage.

scenarios.title: LDAP group discovery suspicion
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review group query activity with legitimate application baselines
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare directory diagnostic records about group lookup with known inventory jobs and client ownership.
scenarios.negative_control: Access reviews, authorization lookups and IAM synchronization.
scenarios.limitations: A lookup alone is not hostile reconnaissance; absence may reflect diagnostic settings.

scenarios.title: LDAP search performance audit
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review expensive search diagnostics with application owners
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review directory search diagnostics with application owners and approved workload context.
scenarios.negative_control: Legitimate reporting or inventory application.
scenarios.limitations: Diagnostic selection and thresholds affect visibility; expensive searches do not establish hostile activity.

scenarios.title: LDAP sensitive object access
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review audited object access with directory ownership records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review audited object identity, access context and authorized role against the sensitive-object inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine directory administration or access review.
scenarios.limitations: Access auditing depends on audit policy and applicable SACL; record alone does not establish harmful use.

scenarios.title: LDAP directory change visibility
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Confirm object modification records reach collection pipeline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare a bounded authoritative object-change export with collector records and change ticket.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved directory maintenance.
scenarios.limitations: A forwarded event does not establish complete directory-change coverage.

scenarios.title: LDAP diagnostic coverage
scenarios.sources: Directory Service; DC Security; identity sensor
scenarios.prerequisites: Verify diagnostic logging and directory auditing where applicable
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review DC diagnostic level and collector availability without changing settings
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare effective LDAP diagnostic configuration, channels and collector health against approved monitoring requirements.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved diagnostic reduction for resource management.
scenarios.limitations: Configuration review cannot prove delivery or enforcement.

scenarios.title: Certificate request visibility
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review request identity, template and CA records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile CA request records with request identity, issuance workflow and approved template inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Ordinary certificate enrollment or renewal.
scenarios.limitations: A request event does not establish issuance or subsequent certificate use.

scenarios.title: Certificate issuance visibility
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Correlate issuance with approved enrollment inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: CA-issued certificate event correlated to request ID, approved template and certificate inventory; compare with the authorized enrollment record.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine approved certificate renewal and auto-enrollment.
scenarios.limitations: Certificate issuance alone does not prove certificate misuse or authentication.

scenarios.title: Certificate request denial
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review denied requests with enrollment support context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review denied-request record and disposition against enrollment policy and support records.
scenarios.negative_control: Expired approval or ordinary enrollment failure.
scenarios.limitations: Denial of one request does not prove all related requests were denied.

scenarios.title: Certificate revocation activity
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review revocations against approved lifecycle actions
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile revocation record with certificate inventory and lifecycle ticket.
scenarios.negative_control: Routine decommissioning or approved replacement.
scenarios.limitations: Revocation event does not establish client-side revocation enforcement.

scenarios.title: CA permission change
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review CA security changes with change approvals
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare CA security changes with before/after access review and approved change ticket.
scenarios.negative_control: Authorized PKI role rotation.
scenarios.limitations: Event presence does not establish effective permissions after inheritance or subsequent changes.

scenarios.title: CA configuration change
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review CA configuration events with PKI administrator baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare CA configuration snapshot and audited change context to the approved maintenance record.
scenarios.negative_control: CA upgrade or approved property change.
scenarios.limitations: 4890 and 4891 describe different configuration changes; inspect actual record rather than treating them as interchangeable.

scenarios.title: Certificate manager settings change
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review certificate manager configuration with approval records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare certificate manager settings before and after the event with approved role policy.
scenarios.negative_control: Planned PKI responsibility reassignment.
scenarios.limitations: Settings-change telemetry does not establish issuance or use of certificates.

scenarios.title: Certificate template load visibility
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review template loading against CA inventory
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile CA template-load record with approved CA template inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Normal service startup or template refresh.
scenarios.limitations: A loaded template does not establish its effective permissions or issuance.

scenarios.title: Certificate template update visibility
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review template changes against change records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare template versions and approved change records with CA template-update observation.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved certificate policy rollout.
scenarios.limitations: CA-side update observation does not establish complete directory-side change history.

scenarios.title: Certificate template permissions update
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review template security change against approval and owner records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review template security change evidence alongside authoritative security descriptor and owner approval.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved delegation change.
scenarios.limitations: Effective permissions require separate review; an event alone does not establish misuse.

scenarios.title: Enrollment permission review
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review authorized template enrollment principals with PKI owners
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review authorized certificate template enrollment ACL inventory and owner-approved enrollment groups.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented enrollment role granted for a valid business requirement.
scenarios.limitations: Effective rights depend on nested membership and CA/template settings.

scenarios.title: Template identity binding review
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review certificate identity binding policy and template risk assessment
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review template identity-binding policy, approved certificate use and change history.
scenarios.negative_control: An approved purpose-specific identity enrollment workflow.
scenarios.limitations: Template settings alone do not establish credential compromise.

scenarios.title: Template purpose review
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review authentication-capable template purposes with business requirements
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare template application purposes with approved certificate use cases and documented owners.
scenarios.negative_control: Authorized application-specific authentication template.
scenarios.limitations: Purpose configuration alone does not establish exploitability or issuance.

scenarios.title: Template approval review
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review manager approval and issuance policy against requirements
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective approval requirements and documented exceptions for the scoped templates.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved unattended enrollment workflow.
scenarios.limitations: Approval settings do not prove actual enforcement for every request.

scenarios.title: Enrollment agent governance
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review enrollment agent permissions and restrictions with PKI owners
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile authorized enrollment-agent roles and restrictions with documented certificate workflows.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved enrollment service performing its assigned role.
scenarios.limitations: Inventory alone does not prove issuance controls are effective.

scenarios.title: CA administrator governance
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Enable Certification Services auditing and collect authorized CA inventory
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review administrative role separation and access reviews
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare CA administrator and certificate manager role inventory with separation-of-duties requirements.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved temporary break-glass assignment.
scenarios.limitations: Role membership does not prove use or misuse of that role.

scenarios.title: CA endpoint protection review
scenarios.sources: CA Security; DC Security; PKI inventory

scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review enrollment endpoint authentication protections and transport policy

scenarios.limitations: A configuration snapshot is not proof of runtime enforcement or exploitability.

scenarios.title: Certificate mapping policy review

scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate destination logon and special-privilege records in the same host/session context against management inventory.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved remote administration or service activity.
scenarios.limitations: Privilege assignment does not establish a privileged operation or malicious movement.

scenarios.title: Remote management source review
scenarios.sources: Endpoint Security; Sysmon; EDR; network IDS
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect endpoint and server audit data; validate clocks and asset identities
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review source host identity against approved management systems
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile destination logon source with approved management inventory and time-valid network context.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved support host or remote access gateway.
scenarios.limitations: Source fields and gateway addresses may not uniquely identify the originating device.

scenarios.title: Domain workstation session anomaly
scenarios.sources: Endpoint Security; Sysmon; EDR; network IDS
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect endpoint and server audit data; validate clocks and asset identities
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review user/device deviations with identity context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate the scoped session with account ownership, expected workstation use and incident context.
scenarios.negative_control: Travel, workstation replacement or approved support activity.
scenarios.limitations: An anomalous session is not proof of compromised domain credentials.

scenarios.title: Lateral movement correlation completeness
scenarios.sources: Endpoint Security; Sysmon; EDR; network IDS
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect endpoint and server audit data; validate clocks and asset identities
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review endpoint, destination and DC source availability
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review whether endpoint, identity and network records share sufficient scope and time context.
scenarios.negative_control: Known collector outage or approved source migration.
scenarios.limitations: Missing telemetry is a coverage limitation, not proof of prevention.

scenarios.title: Administrative share governance
scenarios.sources: Endpoint Security; Sysmon; EDR; network IDS
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect endpoint and server audit data; validate clocks and asset identities
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review approved remote administration and share access policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare approved administrative share access policy and role inventory with documented support requirements.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved management and deployment services.
scenarios.limitations: Share policy is not evidence of actual access or file transfer.

scenarios.title: Domain account creation
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review new identity against onboarding approval
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare the account creation record with the identity provisioning request, creator and owner.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved onboarding and application-account provisioning.
scenarios.limitations: Account creation does not establish unauthorized persistence.

scenarios.title: Domain account deletion
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review identity removal against offboarding records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile account deletion with stable account identity and approved offboarding ticket.
scenarios.negative_control: Normal employee offboarding or cleanup.
scenarios.limitations: Deletion does not prove revocation of all sessions or external access.

scenarios.title: Disabled account enablement
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review enablement against identity lifecycle approvals
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review account enablement actor and target with approved reactivation and owner record.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved returning employee or service recovery.
scenarios.limitations: Enablement does not establish a subsequent sign-in.

scenarios.title: Domain account disablement
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review disablement against approved lifecycle activity
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review disabled-account event with approved lifecycle action and owner confirmation.
scenarios.negative_control: Ordinary offboarding or temporary suspension.
scenarios.limitations: Disablement alone does not prove all existing sessions ended immediately.

scenarios.title: Password reset visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review reset events with helpdesk and account owner records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review reset-attempt outcome, target account and helpdesk authorization.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved account recovery or service maintenance.
scenarios.limitations: 4724 can represent success or failure; reset attempt is not proof of account compromise.

scenarios.title: Account lockout visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review lockout records with authentication context
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review lockout record with scoped authentication timeline and support context.
scenarios.negative_control: Stale saved credentials or ordinary password errors.
scenarios.limitations: Lockout alone does not establish hostile intent or the originating endpoint.

scenarios.title: Privileged group member addition
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review membership additions against access approvals
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare membership change evidence and resulting membership snapshot with the privileged access request.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved just-in-time administration or role assignment.
scenarios.limitations: A group addition does not establish attacker control; assess effective permissions separately.

scenarios.title: Privileged group member removal
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review membership removals against approved changes
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare group membership removal record and approved role-change ticket using stable group and member identity.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved offboarding or access recertification.
scenarios.limitations: Removal does not establish loss of all effective access through other memberships.

scenarios.title: Account setting modification
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review user account changes against baseline and approval
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare user account modification and relevant before/after attributes against approved lifecycle change.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved profile or policy maintenance.
scenarios.limitations: A generic account change does not prove a security-sensitive setting changed.

scenarios.title: Domain password policy review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; identity inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Account Management and Logon auditing
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review effective password policy against organizational requirements
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective password policy and applicable fine-grained policy inventory with approved identity governance.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented policy exceptions for managed identities.
scenarios.limitations: A policy review is not proof of password strength or runtime enforcement.

scenarios.title: Trust creation visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review new trusted domain relationship against approval
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare the new trust record with approved architecture, counterpart ownership and change record.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved merger, migration or integration.
scenarios.limitations: Trust existence does not demonstrate adversarial use.

scenarios.title: Trust removal visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review removed trust relationship against change record
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review the removed trust and approved decommission plan with dependent service owners.
scenarios.negative_control: Planned domain separation or retirement.
scenarios.limitations: Removal is a related trust change, not necessarily adversarial trust manipulation.

scenarios.title: Trust modification visibility
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review trust configuration changes against authorized baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare documented before/after trust configuration and approval with the scoped change record.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved changes during migration or maintenance.
scenarios.limitations: Configuration drift alone does not establish misuse.

scenarios.title: Trust direction review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review trust relationships against business ownership
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare trust direction and business owners with approved cross-domain access design.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved organizational integration or migration.
scenarios.limitations: Trust direction alone does not establish effective cross-domain authorization.

scenarios.title: Trust transitivity review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review transitive relationships against architecture requirements
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review transitivity settings against approved forest/domain architecture and documented exceptions.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved multi-domain design.
scenarios.limitations: Configuration alone does not establish reachable resources or actual authentication.

scenarios.title: Trust SID filtering posture
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review trust protections against approved security policy
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review approved trust configuration snapshots and security architecture decisions with domain owners.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved migration exception with documented expiry.
scenarios.limitations: Settings alone do not establish cross-domain compromise.

scenarios.title: Selective authentication posture
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review trust authentication controls against approved access design
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review effective selective-authentication posture against approved cross-domain access requirements.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved trust migration exception.
scenarios.limitations: Configuration alone does not establish actual enforcement or resource access.

scenarios.title: Cross-domain authentication anomaly
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review identity and destination domain context against authorized flows
scenarios.positive_evidence: Correlate source and destination domain identities in scoped authentication records against approved trust flows.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved cross-domain resource access.
scenarios.limitations: Authentication records alone do not establish unauthorized cross-domain movement.

scenarios.title: Trust inventory completeness
scenarios.sources: DC Security; trust inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect Authentication Policy Change and authorized trust configuration snapshots
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review inventory coverage across in-scope domains and forests
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile trust inventory across authorized domain owners and identify inaccessible or stale sources.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved retired domain or temporary inventory outage.
scenarios.limitations: Partial inventory cannot establish that no additional trusts exist.

scenarios.title: Additional directory credentials review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review identity credential-related changes against approved provisioning
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review independently supplied directory attribute change records with credential governance and identity ownership.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved credential enrollment or rotation.
scenarios.limitations: A generic directory change is not proof of unauthorized credential addition.

scenarios.title: SID history change
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review migration-related identity changes with approved migration records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review SID-history change records alongside migration approval and independently supplied identity evidence.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved domain migration.
scenarios.limitations: A change alone does not establish unauthorized token manipulation or use.

scenarios.title: Privileged group persistence review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review persistent privileged access against periodic access review
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review privileged group changes, access approvals, expiry and resulting membership.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved temporary or permanent role assignment.
scenarios.limitations: Membership change alone cannot demonstrate persistence or actor intent.

scenarios.title: Protected identity permission drift
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review protected identity permissions against approved baseline
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare protected identity effective permissions with dated approved baseline and owner review.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved privileged access recertification.
scenarios.limitations: Permission drift does not prove persistence or actual access.

scenarios.title: Domain audit policy change
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review changes to audit policy against approved maintenance
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare audit policy snapshots and the authorized change record; assess whether logging was actually reduced.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved audit-policy tuning and maintenance.
scenarios.limitations: A policy change event alone does not establish impaired logging.

scenarios.title: Security log clear event
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review log clear evidence with administrator and retention records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review the log-clear event with the responsible administrator, retention record and approved maintenance history.
scenarios.negative_control: Authorized log maintenance or lab reset.
scenarios.limitations: The event establishes a reported clear action, not necessarily malicious intent.

scenarios.title: Directory object restoration
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review restored object against recovery change records
scenarios.positive_evidence: Review directory object undelete record with stable object identity and recovery ticket.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved accidental-deletion recovery.
scenarios.limitations: Restoration does not establish that all prior permissions or services were restored.

scenarios.title: Directory object move
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review moved object and policy scope impact against approval
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare object-move record and before/after location with approved change and policy-scope review.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved OU restructuring.
scenarios.limitations: An object move does not independently prove a resulting policy change or malicious persistence.

scenarios.title: Sensitive identity lifecycle drift
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review dormant, orphaned and unexpected privileged identities
scenarios.positive_evidence: Reconcile dormant and orphaned privileged identities with owner, employment/service status and approved exceptions.
scenarios.negative_control: Approved emergency or rarely used service account.
scenarios.limitations: Inactivity and missing ownership records alone do not establish compromise.

scenarios.title: Defensive sensor coverage review
scenarios.sources: DC Security; EDR; directory inventory
scenarios.prerequisites: Collect directory and account management events; maintain protected-object baseline
scenarios.detection_hypothesis: Review endpoint and DC sensor health, coverage and retention
scenarios.positive_evidence: Compare expected endpoint sensors with the approved asset inventory, source heartbeat and retention status.
scenarios.negative_control: Documented maintenance or approved decommission.
scenarios.limitations: Healthy heartbeat alone does not establish coverage for every security behavior.
